title: llms-txt-generator: generate an llms.txt for AI crawlers
description:
Generates an llms.txt (see llmstxt.org) — the Markdown file at a site root that tells AI crawlers what the site is and points them at its most important pages.

You supply a site name, domain, one-line summary and your key pages; it emits a title line, a blockquote summary and a grouped, linked, described page list, ready to save as llms.txt at your domain root.

Runs entirely in the browser. A single static page — index.html plus app.js — with no build step, no dependencies, no server, and nothing uploaded.
